STEP 1 - Scene: A plated meal with mashed potatoes, fried onions (or crispy shallot-like topping), smoked sausage/kielbasa-style chunks, and broccoli florets.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Mashed potatoes
- Crispy fried onions
- Sausage pieces (about 7 chunks)
- Broccoli florets

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate):
- Mashed potatoes: ~20% (106 cm^2)
- Fried onions: ~12% (64 cm^2)
- Sausage pieces: ~14% (74 cm^2)
- Broccoli: ~10% (53 cm^2)
Total food coverage ≈ 56% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume (area x height):
- Mashed potatoes: 106 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 265 ml
- Fried onions: 64 cm^2 x 1.0 cm ≈ 64 ml
- Sausage: 74 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 111 ml
- Broccoli: 53 cm^2 x 2.0 cm ≈ 106 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Mashed potatoes: 265 ml x 0.9 ≈ 240 g
- Fried onions: 64 ml x 0.4 ≈ 26 g (light, airy topping)
- Sausage: 111 ml x 0.95 ≈ 105 g
- Broccoli: 106 ml x 0.55 ≈ 58 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Mashed potatoes (with butter/milk): 240 g x 110 kcal/100 g ≈ 264 kcal
- Fried onions: 26 g x 400 kcal/100 g ≈ 104 kcal
- Sausage: 105 g x 300 kcal/100 g ≈ 315 kcal
- Broccoli: 58 g x 34 kcal/100 g ≈ 20 kcal
Total ≈ 703 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 470 g of food covering just over half a dinner plate, with roughly 700 kcal, is plausible for a full hot dinner portion.
